42887-cheshire.title: Cheshire
42887-cheshire.creator: Unknown
42887-cheshire.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Few English counties owe more of their history to their geographical position and surroundings, and to the character of their natural features, than Cheshire. Not only in the past have the rocks and rivers of Cheshire helped to make history, but even to-day they have a very direct bearing upon the fortunes of Cheshire men and women.

arxiv-2003-13512.title: The Subelliptic Heat Kernel of the Octonionic Anti-De Sitter Fibration
arxiv-2003-13512.creator: Fabrice BAUDOIN and Gunhee CHO
arxiv-2003-13512.description: Abstract In this note, we study the sub-Laplacian of the 15 15 -dimensional octonionic anti-de Sitter space which is obtained by lifting with respect to the anti-de Sitter fibration the Laplacian of the octonionic hyperbolic space 𝕆 ​ H 1 \mathbb{O}H^{1} . We also obtain two integral representations for the corresponding subelliptic heat kernel.

arxiv-2104-07779.title: An ALMA Gas-dynamical Mass Measurement of the Supermassive Black Hole in the Local Compact Galaxy UGC 2698
arxiv-2104-07779.creator: Jonathan H. Cohn, Jonelle L. Walsh, Benjamin D. Boizelle, Aaron J. Barth, Karl Gebhardt, Kayhan Gültekin, Akın Yıldırım, David A. Buote, Jeremy Darling, Andrew J. Baker, Luis C. Ho, Kyle M. Kabasares
arxiv-2104-07779.description: Abstract We present 0 . ′′ \farcs 14-resolution Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) CO(2 − - 1) observations of the circumnuclear gas disk in UGC 2698, a local compact galaxy. The disk exhibits regular rotation with projected velocities rising to 450 450 km s -1 near the galaxy center.

arxiv-2207-10649.title: Multilingual Disinformation Detection for Digital Advertising
arxiv-2207-10649.creator: Žofia Trsťanová, Nadir El Manouzi, Maryline Chen, Andre L. V. da Cunha, Sergei Ivanov
arxiv-2207-10649.description: Abstract In today’s world, the presence of online disinformation and propaganda is more widespread than ever. Independent publishers are funded mostly via digital advertising, which is unfortunately also the case for those publishing disinformation content. The question of how to remove such publishers from advertising inventory has long been ignored, despite the negative impact on the open internet.

arxiv-2208-01213.title: Time-Dependent Performance Modeling for Platooning Communications at Intersection
arxiv-2208-01213.creator: Qiong Wu, Yu Zhao, Qiang Fan
arxiv-2208-01213.description: Abstract With the development of internet of vehicles, platooning strategy has been widely studied as the potential approach to ensure the safety of autonomous driving. Vehicles in the form of platoon adopt 802.11p to exchange messages through vehicle to vehicle (V2V) communications.

arxiv-2209-01906.title: Deciding Graph Property by Single Mobile Agent: One-Bit Memory Suffices A part of this paper was presented in the 2018 ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing (PODC2018) as a brief announcement.
arxiv-2209-01906.creator: Taisuke Izumi, Kazuki Kakizawa, Yuya Kawabata, Naoki Kitamura, Toshimitsu Masuzawa
arxiv-2209-01906.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Taisuke Izumi, Kazuki Kakizawa, Yuya Kawabata, Naoki Kitamura, Toshimitsu Masuzawa. We investigate the computational power of the deterministic single-agent model where the agent and each node are equipped with a limited amount of persistent memory. Tasks are formalized as decision problems on properties of input graphs, i.e., the task is defined as a subset 𝒯 \mathcal{T} of all possible input graphs, and the agent must decide if the network belongs to 𝒯 \mathcal{T} or not.

arxiv-2210-10348.title: Pole inflation and primordial black holes
arxiv-2210-10348.creator: formation in Starobinsky-like supergravity
arxiv-2210-10348.description: Abstract January 2023 IPMU22-0049 revised version Abstract We extend the Cecotti-Kallosh model of Starobinsky inflation in supergravity by adding a holomorphic function to the superpotential in order to generate a large peak in the power spectrum of scalar (curvature) perturbations.

arxiv-2402-00117.title: Spontaneously Broken ( − 𝟏 ) \bm{(-1)} -Form U(1) Symmetries
arxiv-2402-00117.creator: Daniel Aloni, Eduardo García-Valdecasas, Matthew Reece, Motoo Suzuki
arxiv-2402-00117.description: Abstract Spontaneous breaking of symmetries leads to universal phenomena. We extend this notion to ( − 1 ) (-1) -form U(1) symmetries. The spontaneous breaking is diagnosed by a dependence of the vacuum energy on a constant background field θ \theta , which can be probed by the topological susceptibility.

arxiv-2403-07805.title: Beyond Memorization: The Challenge of Random Memory Access in Language Models
arxiv-2403-07805.creator: Tongyao Zhu, Qian Liu, Liang Pang, Zhengbao Jiang, Min-Yen Kan Min Lin
arxiv-2403-07805.description: Abstract Recent developments in Language Models (LMs) have shown their effectiveness in NLP tasks, particularly in knowledge-intensive tasks. However, the mechanisms underlying knowledge storage and memory access within their parameters remain elusive. In this paper, we investigate whether a generative LM (e.g., GPT-2) is able to access its memory sequentially or randomly.

arxiv-2407-00989.title: f ⁡ ( Q , ℒ m ) f(Q,\mathcal{L}_{m}) gravity, and its cosmological implications
arxiv-2407-00989.creator: Ayush Hazarika, Simran Arora, P.K. Sahoo, Tiberiu Harko
arxiv-2407-00989.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ayush Hazarika, Simran Arora, P.K. Sahoo, Tiberiu Harko. Symmetric teleparallel gravity and its f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) extensions have emerged as promising alternatives to General Relativity (GR), yet the role of explicit geometry–matter couplings remains largely unexplored. In this work, we address this gap by proposing a generalized f ⁡ ( Q , ℒ m ) f(Q,\mathcal{L}_{m}) theory, where the gravitational Lagrangian density depends on both the non-metricity scalar Q Q and the matter Lagrangian ℒ m \mathcal{L}_{m} .

arxiv-2409-16849.title: Exposing Assumptions in AI Benchmarks through Cognitive Modelling
arxiv-2409-16849.creator: Jonathan H. Rystrøm, Kenneth C. Enevoldsen
arxiv-2409-16849.description: Abstract Cultural AI benchmarks often rely on implicit assumptions about measured constructs, leading to vague formulations with poor validity and unclear interrelations. We propose exposing these assumptions using explicit cognitive models formulated as Structural Equation Models. Using cross-lingual alignment transfer as an example, we show how this approach can answer key research questions and identify missing datasets.

arxiv-2411-16608.title: Barriers on the EDGE: A scalable CBF architecture over EDGE for safe aerial-ground multi-agent coordination Thanks: The authors are with the Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Group of the Department of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineering at Luleå University of Technology, Sweden. T
arxiv-2411-16608.creator: Viswa Narayanan Sankaranarayanan *, Achilleas Santi Seisa, Akshit Saradagi, Sumeet Satpute
arxiv-2411-16608.description: Abstract In this article, we propose a control architecture for the safe, coordinated operation of a multi-agent system with aerial (UAVs) and ground (UGVs) robots in a confined task space. We consider the case where the aerial and ground operations are coupled, enabled by the capability of the aerial robots to land on moving ground robots.

arxiv-2506-04408.title: Unpacking Let Alone : Human-Scale Models Generalize to a Rare Construction in Form but not Meaning
arxiv-2506-04408.creator: Wesley Scivetti, Tatsuya Aoyama, Ethan Wilcox, Nathan Schneider
arxiv-2506-04408.description: Abstract Humans have a remarkable ability to acquire and understand grammatical phenomena that are seen rarely, if ever, during childhood. Recent evidence suggests that language models with human-scale pretraining data may possess a similar ability by generalizing from frequent to rare constructions.

arxiv-2510-17023.title: Enrich and Detect: Video Temporal Grounding with Multimodal LLMs
arxiv-2510-17023.creator: Shraman Pramanick Effrosyni Mavroudi Yale Song Rama Chellappa, Lorenzo Torresani Triantafyllos Afouras
arxiv-2510-17023.description: Abstract We introduce ED-VTG , a method for fine-grained video temporal grounding utilizing multi-modal large language models. Our approach harnesses the capabilities of multimodal LLMs to jointly process text and video, in order to effectively localize natural language queries in videos through a two-stage process.

pmc-10492400.title: Diversity and functional prediction of fungal communities in different segments of mongolian horse gastrointestinal tracts
pmc-10492400.creator: Yiping Zhao, Xiujuan Ren, Haiqing Wu, He Hu, Chao Cheng, Ming Du, Yao Huang, Xiaoqing Zhao, Liwei Wang, Liuxi Yi, Jinshan Tao, Yajing Li, Yanan Lin, Shaofeng Su, Manglai Dugarjaviin
pmc-10492400.description: BackgroundAnaerobic fungi are effective fibre-degrading microorganisms in the digestive tract of horses. However, our understanding of their diversity and community structure is limited, especially in different parts of the gastrointestinal tract.ResultsFor the first time, high-throughput sequencing technology was used to analyse and predict fungal microbial diversity in different parts of the gastrointestinal tract of Mongolian horses.

pmc-10631715.title: CAR-T Cell Therapy in Large B Cell Lymphoma
pmc-10631715.creator: Ugo Testa, Giuseppe Leone, Elvira Pelosi, Germana Castelli, Stefan Hohaus
pmc-10631715.description: Large B-cell lymphomas (LBCLs) are among the most frequent (about 30%) non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. Despite the aggressive behavior of these lymphomas, more than 60% of patients can be cured with first-line chemoimmunotherapy using the R-CHOP regimen. Patients with refractory or relapsing disease show a poor outcome even when treated with second-line therapies.

pmc-12381043.title: Ultralong organic afterglow from small molecular host-guest materials: state of the art
pmc-12381043.creator: Yuxin Xiao, Mingyao Shen, Chin-Yiu Chan, Tao Yu, Wei Huang
pmc-12381043.description: Ultralong organic afterglow materials are being actively explored as attractive candidates for a wide range of applications such as data storage, security inks, emergency lighting, etc., due to their unique long-lived excited state properties and inherent advantages of low cost, appreciable functionality and ease of preparation.

pmc-12645930.title: PRRSV GP2a blocks the RLR signaling pathway by targeting RIG-I
pmc-12645930.creator: Yingjie Xiang, Chunxiao Mou, Xing Zhao, Chen Zhuo, Kaichuang Shi, Yun Young Go, Zhenhai Chen

pmc-13526281.title: Anesthetic Management of Tracheal Resection and Anastomosis for Postintubation Tracheal Stenosis Involving a Sequential Airway Strategy
pmc-13526281.creator: Mohammad Zishan Uddin, Maliha Karim, Md Abdul Karim, Md Abdullah-Al-Mahammud Kabir, Hasib Ahamed, Md Shahinur Rahman, Niaz Ahmed, Shashank Kaushik
pmc-13526281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). A postintubation tracheal stenotic patient who requires surgical resection and anastomosis is a challenging case for an anesthesiologist, requiring meticulous planning during surgical correction due to a shared airway. This case report is about the anesthetic management of a 23‐year‐old male who developed severe tracheal stenosis following prolonged mechanical ventilation after decompressive craniectomy and presented with severe dyspnea, wheeze, and stridor five weeks later. Tracheal resection and anastomosis were the ultimate solution for this patient.

pmc-13545772.title: Thermo-mechanical loading of innovative “Mini-skirt” preparation design versus conventional full-coverage maxillary central incisor preparation design: an in vitro study
pmc-13545772.creator: Mohammad Rayyan, Rana Walid Tawil, Dana El Ballouli, Ehab A. Farghaly, Radwa Ibrahim Eltahawi, Mohamed B. A. Badawy, Omar Badran, Omayma Tantawy Said Mohammed, Alaa Mohamed Naguib, Nasser Hussein Shaheen, Mohamed Sayed, Sahar Mokhtar, Mohammed Moustafa Shalaby, Hatem M. Ibrahim, Maha Fouad
pmc-13545772.description: BackgroundConventional full-coverage anterior crown preparations for zirconia often require substantial enamel and dentine reduction and may concentrate palatal-cervical stresses, risking marginal discrepancy and compromised seal. A conservative “Mini-skirt” (MS) design that positions the palatal finish line coronally (above the cingulum) could preserve tooth structure and enhance adhesive support, but its thermo-mechanical performance under thermal cycling and fatigue loading remains unclear.

pmc-13589181.title: Types of Screen Time and Developmental Outcomes Among Children Aged 0–6 Years in Thailand: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13589181.creator: Sukritta Jaichomcheun, Wachira Suriyawong, Pataporn Bawornthip, Su‐Ru Chen
pmc-13589181.description: IntroductionExcessive screen time during early childhood can affect developmental outcomes. However, evidence on the differential effects of screen time types in Thailand remains limited. In this study, we examined associations between different types of screen time and developmental outcomes among children aged 0–6 years in Thailand.MethodsThis cross‐sectional study was conducted in community kindergartens and primary healthcare centres in Thailand.
